items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Me and my wife and Piku, Julius Piku and St. Paper George, we used to play there on Friday Sunday night.

ctx.x: And I had that bass for me and my wife, and I showed my wife how to play guitar, too. She can play guitar and play my little bass, too. She can play piano and organ. Well, we used to play the Auto Crack on Fridays and Sunday. Me and my wife and Piku, Julius Piku and St. Paper George, we used to play there on Friday Sunday night. I thought we used to play there.
What happened to Sandpaper George? He'd been there.
